sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy, Real Estate, and Healthcare are the only sectors maintaining perfect "all-green" status, while Utilities and Communication Services lead the week's declines amid a mild rotation into defensive and financial pockets.

Energy continues to dominate the US sector landscape, holding the top spot with a momentum score of 0.95 and maintaining its all-green status alongside Real Estate (0.67) and Healthcare (0.62). We are seeing a minor rotation into defensive and value-oriented sectors, with Consumer Defensive, Financials, and Healthcare all gaining one rank spot over the last five sessions.

Conversely, growth and yield-sensitive sectors are fading. Utilities experienced the sharpest drop, falling 2 spots to rank 8, while Communication Services slipped 1 spot to rank 10. Consumer Cyclical remains the absolute momentum laggard at a weak 0.17 score, sitting at the bottom of the YTD rankings.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 groups are currently "all-green" (positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD).
* **Energy Dominance:** Energy remains the undisputed leader, holding the rank 1 spot with a near-perfect momentum score of 0.95.
* **Defensive and Real Assets:** Real Estate (rank 4, momentum 0.67) and Healthcare (rank 9, momentum 0.62) round out the all-green list, showing robust medium-to-long-term performance.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Consumer Defensive (rank 6, momentum 0.42), Financials (rank 7, momentum 0.62), and Healthcare (rank 9, momentum 0.62) each improved their rank by +1 spot over the last 5 sessions.
* **Top Losers:** Utilities fell -2 spots to rank 8 (momentum 0.37), and Communication Services dropped -1 spot to rank 10 (momentum 0.33).
* **Momentum Polarization:** A wide gap exists between momentum leaders like Technology (0.70, rank 2) and laggards like Consumer Cyclical (0.17, rank 11).

## Divergences
* **Industrials Disconnect:** Industrials holds a high YTD rank of 3 despite a weak momentum score of 0.37, indicating potential vulnerability to future rank downgrades.
* **Healthcare Under-ranking:** Healthcare is technically all-green and shows strong momentum (0.62), yet it remains suppressed at rank 9, indicating a late-stage recovery that has not yet reflected in its YTD rank.
* **No Fragile All-Green Signals:** There are currently no active early-warning divergences or fragile all-green ratings among the leading sectors.

rotation_phase.reasoning: Energy's dominant leadership in momentum and YTD performance, paired with emerging strength in defensive areas like Healthcare and Real Estate, characterizes a classic Late Cycle transition.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive REITs and Oil & Gas Refining continue to anchor market strength, while a sharp decline in education and industrial metals contrasts with emerging value and staple rotations.

Market breadth remains selective, with 30 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green status across all time horizons. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing continues to dominate as the top momentum leader (0.984), closely followed by defensive sectors like REIT - Healthcare Facilities (0.903) and Consumer Electronics (0.887). Rotation is evident as value-oriented and consumer groups like Shell Companies (+22 spots) and Department Stores (+18 spots) surge, while Staffing & Employment Services (+16 spots, momentum 0.85) cements its position as both a top gainer and a sustained leader.

On the downside, cyclical and educational groups are fading rapidly. Education & Training Services (-23 spots) and Aluminum (-21 spots) experienced severe weekly rank declines, reflecting a broader cooling in industrial and discretionary niches. Furthermore, early-warning signals reveal a momentum peak in previously strong areas like Food Distribution (-9 spots) and Oil & Gas Midstream (-5 spots), whereas low-momentum defensive staples like Wineries & Distilleries and Packaged Foods are starting to climb the ranks.

## Strength
* **All-Green Breadth:** 30 out of 144 groups are all-green across all time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD), led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.98) and REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.90).
* **Sustained Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, REIT - Healthcare Facilities, Consumer Electronics, and Trucking remain the absolute anchors of market strength, holding top ranks across 1, 3, and 6 months.
* **Defensive Clusters:** Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.84) and REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.87) continue to display robust, multi-horizon positive performance.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Shell Companies (+22 spots to rank 74, momentum 0.39) and Department Stores (+18 spots to rank 98, momentum 0.64) led the weekly rank improvements, alongside Staffing & Employment Services (+16 spots to rank 18, momentum 0.85).
* **Top Losers:** Education & Training Services fell 23 spots to rank 94 (momentum 0.27), while Aluminum dropped 21 spots to rank 85 (momentum 0.27).
* **Momentum Extremes:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads overall momentum at 0.984, while Airports & Air Services (0.076) and Mortgage Finance (0.103) sit at the absolute bottom of the YTD rankings.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Food Distribution (momentum 0.60) dropped 9 spots and Oil & Gas Midstream (momentum 0.72) fell 5 spots over the last 5 sessions despite historically strong momentum.
* **Emerging Groups:** Shell Companies (+22 spots, momentum 0.39) and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+13 spots, momentum 0.46) are jumping in rank despite still having low overall momentum scores.
* **Commodity & Tech Softening:** Steel (momentum 0.67) and Communication Equipment (momentum 0.64) are showing early signs of fatigue, slipping 3 and 2 spots respectively in the last 5 days.
